# Onion soup

Type: Food | Internal ID: OnionSoup | Source: Cauldron | Usage: Crafting, Eating | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Crafting Materials: Onion x3 | Max Health: 20 | Max Stamina: 60 | Duration: 20m | Healing: 1 hp/tick

# Introduction

Onion soup is a Mountains-tier food.

## Recipe

Onion soup is produced in a level 2 Cauldron with:
• 3 Onion

### Crafting

• Hearty Mountain logger's stew

## Notes

• Onion soup provides the second-highest stamina gain in the Mountains at 60, second to Eyescream at 65.
• Onion soup makes up for providing less stamina than Eyescream by being much easier to obtain, only requiring one growable item.

Categorias: Food, Cooking recipes
